youtube.title: Marie Antoinette apologized to her executioner. Seriously 🙏 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Marie Antoinette's last words were… an apology to the executioner 🙏

Polite to the very end, or the coldest move in history? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: on 16 October 1793, on the scaffold in Paris, Marie Antoinette accidentally stepped on the executioner's foot. Her reported last words: "Pardonnez-moi, monsieur, je ne l'ai pas fait exprès" ("Pardon me, sir, I didn't do it on purpose"). She almost certainly never said "let them eat cake": the line appears in Rousseau's Confessions, written when she was a child in Austria.
